gen-gf-calligraffitti-fs-asap: Friendly marker-traced curves lead in Calligraffitti, with a tall midzone and counters that spill outward. Asap follows in plain sans, its c forms open arcs and its lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals, so a few lines read easily.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-fs-epilogue: Epilogue reads as curvy and approachable, a wire-like monoline sans with tall lowercase and stubby ascender tips. And Calligraffitti sits above it with marker-drawn warmth, though the pair is better kept off long paragraphs.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-fs-erode:
Erode reads dignified, with a tall middle band and a gentle ebb of stroke weight.

Calligraffitti's marker-traced thread of a line sits against that restrained classic serif, and the pairing works best for brief copy.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-fs-familjen-grotes: Calligraffitti's n arches are as thick as the stems beside them, giving the marker-drawn heading a friendly, graceful presence. Handwriting meets grotesk.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-fs-fira-sans: Loose marker charm meets tidy structure. Calligraffitti's towering midzone leans on Fira Sans, a plain sans with wide-open s curves and a generous x-height, and that contrast is the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-fs-public-sans: Public Sans brings a hefty lowercase and broad open counters on c and s, built for trustworthy clarity. And Calligraffitti keeps a steady pen pressure from first letter to last, which is why the pair favors brief copy.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-fs-supreme:
Calligraffitti draws friendly letters with the constant weight of a stencil-cut channel and a towering midzone.

Supreme follows in a crisp plain sans, a heavy-looking strip of text with letters held open, good for a handful of lines.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-general-sans: Hand-lettered warmth, then clean order: Calligraffitti's marker strokes tower over the line before things settle down. General Sans fills each line with a tall x-height and smooth bends, yet this sans is not meant for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-manrope:
Calligraffitti hands over its marker-traced warmth first.

Manrope then follows in a plain sans with bright open mouths on every curve and one steady line width, though the pairing is better kept for brief copy than a long page.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-montserrat: Montserrat reads geometric and approachable, with generous white space leading into each curve and oversized e and a counters. Its line glides, best in small doses.
